event_chain.summary: Use of retained (stolen) credentials to Flock LPR
Plate reader data queried for stalking

summary: Andrae Wright, a former Effingham County Sheriff's Office employee then working as an investigator for the Ogeechee Circuit District Attorney's Office, retained login access to the Effingham County Sheriff's Office Flock Safety license plate reader system and accessed it more than 60 times between June 15 and July 5, 2026, for non-law-enforcement purposes. The sheriff's office found the misuse in an internal audit and reported it to the GBI on July 9; Wright was arrested July 27, 2026 and charged with misuse of a license plate reader system, stalking, computer invasion of privacy and violation of oath of office.
